scope.flow: GrowthHYBR auto-compounding vault share accounting via VotingEscrow veNFT locked amount
scope.environment: GrowthHYBR vault contract and VotingEscrow contract

statements.text: GrowthHYBR internally creates and manages a single veNFT in VotingEscrow in which all deposited HYBR is locked.
GrowthHYBR share calculation is based on the ratio between totalSupply() (total gHYBR shares) and totalAssets() (total HYBR locked in the veNFT).
VotingEscrow::deposit_for() is publicly accessible and allows anyone to add HYBR tokens to any existing veNFT.
GrowthHYBR::totalAssets() directly reads the locked amount from the veNFT, which includes any externally-added tokens.
Attacker directly calls VotingEscrow::deposit_for() to increase the locked amount of the GrowthHYBR-owned veNFT.
Because totalAssets() reads the veNFT locked amount including externally-added tokens, totalAssets can be inflated without proportionally increasing totalSupply.
Inflation of totalAssets() via external additions to the veNFT must not occur without a proportional increase in totalSupply(), so that share pricing is not diluted for subsequent depositors.
Adding HYBR to the GrowthHYBR-owned veNFT through VotingEscrow::deposit_for() should not be possible for arbitrary external callers in a way that alters vault share accounting.

ambiguities: Report does not specify the exact numeric bound or formula for share dilution beyond the ratio description.
Report does not state whether the attacker must be a depositor or hold any prior shares before calling deposit_for().
Report does not give a concrete transaction sequence or amounts for the inflation scenario.
